 Sam Drury, Emlyn Begley, Jess Anderson and Emily Salley
 Most recent Most popular GOAL - Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool published at 73 mins 73 mins 
 Archie Brown 
 Fenerbahce equalise again and it's the Englishman who has scored it!
 A corner from the right is played short, N'Golo Kante swings in the cross and Cody Gakpo's glancing header takes the ball away from Alisson.
 Waiting at the far post with the goal gaping is Archie Brown to tap it home. Level again!
 282 1041 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Gakpo always impacts the game' published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 What a great ball in by Gakpo. He has only just come on, but he always impacts the game.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 273 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Good header' from Isak to put Liverpool in front published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Yeah, it's a good header isn't it. I thought that he could put it further back across goal if I was nit picking a little bit. It's a good move, Gakpo gets a bit of room down that left hand side, and then hangs the ball up towards the back-post area
 The goalkeeper gets a hand to it doesn't he, but clearly can't keep it out.
 281 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 71 mins 71 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Just like in the first half, Liverpool cause themselves problems as soon as they get ahead.
 A pass back to Alisson isn't the easiest to deal with but he'd still hope to do better than thump his clearance straight into Jeremy Jacquet.
 The centre-back ends up giving away a free-kick but Liverpool clear and Bradley Barcola leads the counter.
 67 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Isak's solid form continues published at 19:16 GMT 19:16 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 It's all smiles in the Liverpool dug out. The two substitutes combine and Isak's solid run of form continues. That's his seventh goal of the season. That Liverpool away end is in full voice now.
 425 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool published at 69 mins 69 mins 
 Alexander Isak 
 That didn't take long!
 Two substitutes combine with Cody Gakpo, after exchanging passes with Kostas Tsimikas, gets to the bye-line and hangs up a cross.
 Alexander Isak is there waiting and there is too much power on his header from a couple of yards out, Ederson can't keep it out and Liverpool lead again.
 Image source, PA Media 
 2559 228 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:13 GMT 19:13 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Yeah I do, [like the fact that Iraola made three substitutions]. Time will tell, but I just think that it was freshen them up and, it hasn't weakened them it's strengthened them.
 328 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Those changes have seen Dominik Szoboszlai go in at right-back. Bradley Barcola has moved out to the right with Cody Gakpo on the left.
 196 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Yep, here come the cavalry.
 Florian Wirtz, Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak are on.
 Off go Joe Gomez, Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz. Both wingers have been lively without any real reward.
 373 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Iraola turns to his bench published at 19:09 GMT 19:09 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 Andoni Iraola is ready to turn to his bench. Cody Gakpo, Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak are all about to come on.
 355 66 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:09 GMT 19:09 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 [Victor Munoz] be thinking why didn't I hit that first time.
 It's not a bad ball from Gomez and you just have the feeling that Liverpool are getting nearer and nearer.
 160 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 64 mins 64 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Nice play from Archie Brown as Fenerbahce come forward again.
 The left-back gets past Joe Gomez and shoots right-footed from 20 yards. Dragged wide.
 34 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 First change of the day from either manager as Dirk Kuyt takes off Romelu Lukaku and sends on in-form striker Vedat Muriqi.
 34 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:08 GMT 19:08 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Is it too late for Tuchel to include Nyoni in the next England squad?
 Will, Surrey 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 248 146 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Joe Gomez has never scored an official goal for Liverpool - sadly, his penalty in the shootout against Chelsea last week doesn't count - and shows why with a horrible, wayward shot.
 The ball comes to him on the edge of the box soon afterwards and this time he tees up Victor Munoz. The Spain winger cuts inside his man before his shot is hacked over the bar by Milan Skriniar.
 80 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 60 mins 60 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 A half chance from nothing for Fenerbahce as Victor Munoz tracks back well but then hits his clearance straight at Archie Brown.
 The ball drops kindly for the full-back and he forces a save from Alisson. A reminder to Liverpool not to relax.
 111 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'You expect Van Dijk to score' published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 That should've been 2-1. Virgil van Dijk gets the header relatively unchallenged and you expect him to score. He should've.
 268 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 57 mins 57 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Two decent efforts in the space of a few seconds for Liverpool.
 Firstly, Bradley Barcola cuts in from the left and hits a firm shot that Ederson bundles wide of the post.
 From the resulting corner, Virgil van Dijk gets up well and powers a header goalwards. Too close to Ederson.
 201 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 56 mins 56 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Dominik Szoboszlai quite rightly opts again shooting, shifts the ball to Kostas Tsimikas and he crosses to the back post.
 Virgil van Dijk tries to head back across goal but Fenerbahce clear and break.
 Try Nyoni is there, though, and makes a good tackle to end the counter.
 253 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 55 mins 55 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Much more like the start of the first half than the end of it so far since the break.
 Liverpool on top and controlling things form inside the Fenerbahce half.
 Another free-kick gives Dominik Szoboszlai a sight of goal. Albeit from fully 35 yards...
